categoryName: Oral care — toothpaste, brush, mouthwash, floss, denture care

skuLines.examples: Colgate Strong Teeth 200g, Pepsodent Germicheck 150g, Colgate Cibaca 175g, Close Up Red Hot 150g
skuLines.seasonality: Spikes at session opening (Apr, Jul, post-winter-break Feb) when ~5,000 residents restock in the same week
skuLines.notes: The price-known anchor SKU — never be out of stock, residents notice. Heavy and low value-density, so freight per rupee of sale is the worst in the whole lane; buy on the biggest carton slab the distributor gives.

skuLines.line: Toothpaste — entry / small tube and sachet
skuLines.examples: Colgate Dental Cream 18g & 40g, Cibaca 40g, Dabur Babool 45g, ₹10 sachets
skuLines.seasonality: Session opening; also end-of-month when school-student pocket money runs out
skuLines.notes: The cash-constrained 5-18 student format and the item a day-visitor buys. Tiny ticket but high bill-count — this is the shape that keeps 7.2 bills/resident/month up.

skuLines.examples: Dabur Red 200g, Patanjali Dant Kanti 200g, Vicco Vajradanti, Himalaya Complete Care 150g
skuLines.notes: Keep a herbal option beside every mass SKU: vegetarian / no-animal-derived-glycerine positioning genuinely matters to observant residents of a Sikh institution, and ayurvedic is the default preference of the non-teaching staff cohort.

skuLines.line: Toothpaste — neem / salt / miswak functional variants
skuLines.examples: Colgate Active Salt 200g, Dabur Meswak 200g, Dabur Babool 175g, Colgate Swarna Vedshakti
skuLines.notes: Asked for by name ("namak wala", "meswak") — a herbal SKU is not a substitute for these. Two facings is enough.

skuLines.examples: Close Up Everfresh 150g, Colgate MaxFresh Peppermint 150g, Pepsodent Gum Care gel, Colgate Lemon Fresh Gel
skuLines.notes: The 18-25 Eternal University block buys gel over cream. Cheap to stock, fast-moving, and the cohort with the most disposable cash on campus.

skuLines.examples: Colgate Visible White 100g, Colgate Visible White Purple 240g, Himalaya Sparkling White 150g, Closeup White Attraction
skuLines.notes: Purple colour-corrector has gone mass in 2025-26 (Colgate now has a 240g SKU) — carry one mass purple plus one classic whitening paste.

skuLines.examples: Colgate Charcoal Clean 120g, Dabur Activated Charcoal, Patanjali charcoal, Vithoba charcoal
skuLines.notes: Trend-driven and now plateauing; one facing. Black paste stains the shelf and basins — front-face it away from white goods.

skuLines.examples: Sensodyne Fresh Mint 70g/150g, Colgate Sensitive Pro-Relief 70g, Vantej 100g, Thermoseal RA 70g
skuLines.seasonality: Real winter spike Nov-Feb — brushing in near-freezing hill water makes sensitivity complaints jump
skuLines.notes: Highest-value paste a hill store can hold, and the substitute is a 30-50 km trip. Stock two brands and two sizes — brand loyalty here is unusually sticky because switching hurts.

skuLines.line: Toothpaste — gum care / anti-tartar / total protection
skuLines.examples: Colgate Total 120g, Parodontax 75g, Colgate Periogard, Himalaya Ayurveda Gum Care 80g/150g
skuLines.notes: Bought by the 40+ teaching staff and elderly after a dental visit. Shelve next to the interdental brushes and chlorhexidine — it is the same buyer on the same trip.

skuLines.examples: Perfora nano-HAP, Himalaya Botanique Whitening+ Hydroxyapatite 113g (₹444), Oracura natural, Dr Sheth's
skuLines.notes: The fastest-growing premium hook of 2025-26 and the highest margin in the aisle, but thin demand in a township — 1-2 facings, and only if a specific staff family asks. Overbuy here and it sits.

skuLines.examples: Thermoseal RA 70g, Clohex paste, Emoform-R, Sensoform
skuLines.notes: Comes down the pharma distributor route (ICPA, Indoco), not the FMCG one — a separate vendor to open. Medicated SKUs need a Form 20/21 retail drug licence; check ARY holds one before listing.

skuLines.examples: Dentoshine gel 80g (IDA accepted), MeeMee fluoride-free strawberry, Chicco 0-3, Mamaearth Fruit Punch 50g
skuLines.notes: Married-staff families with toddlers have no other source within 30-50 km. Fluoride-free / swallow-safe is the buying criterion — an adult paste is not a substitute and a parent will make the trip rather than accept one. Long shelf life, so depth is safe.

skuLines.line: Toothpaste — kids 6-12, character pack / low fluoride
skuLines.examples: Colgate Kids Barbie & Batman 80g, Pepsodent Kids, Clove Kidz colour-changing 100g, Little Joys multivitamin
skuLines.seasonality: Session opening — hostel wardens restock junior blocks in case lots
skuLines.notes: Akal Academy's 5-18 residential students are the single largest cohort ARY serves. Character packs move on pocket money; colour-changing pastes are the 2026 novelty that actually sells to this age.

skuLines.examples: Dabur Lal Dant Manjan 100g/200g, Baidyanath Lal Dant Manjan 200g, Vithoba 80g, Farooky 40g
skuLines.notes: Older non-teaching staff and elderly residents buy powder, not paste — dropping this line quietly loses a whole cohort. Heavy monsoon humidity cakes it solid: buy small tins and sachets, keep off the floor, strict FIFO Jul-Sep.

skuLines.examples: Colgate tooth powder 100g, Vicco tooth powder, black tooth powder
skuLines.notes: Same humidity caveat as ayurvedic powder. One SKU is enough alongside the manjan.

skuLines.examples: Sensoform gum paint, Amdent gum paint, Dabur gum paint
skuLines.notes: Still asked for by name by the 40+ cohort. Small glass bottles — pack carefully for the hill road.

skuLines.line: Oil pulling oil / medicated dental oil
skuLines.examples: Dabur Red Pulling Oil 200ml, cold-pressed coconut pulling oil, Zandu Dantveer Irimedadi oil
skuLines.notes: Ayurveda repackaged as a 2026 retail format. Coconut-based oils solidify below ~24°C — in a cold hill winter customers will think the bottle has gone bad; tell them, or stock the non-coconut version.

skuLines.examples: Baidyanath Lavang Tel, Dabur clove oil 5-10ml, ayurvedic dental drops
skuLines.notes: The 2 a.m. toothache item in a township whose dentist is 30-50 km of hill road away. Negligible value, disproportionate goodwill — this is the SKU residents remember ARY for.

skuLines.examples: Zytee RB gel 10g, Dologel CT, Mucopain 20g, Smyle gel
skuLines.seasonality: Exam-stress periods and summer; hostel-mess diet drives a steady base
skuLines.notes: These are drugs — needs a retail drug licence (Form 20/21). If ARY has no licence, carry the ayurvedic ulcer gels and honey-based applications instead rather than skipping the need.

skuLines.examples: Colgate Cibaca soft, Ajanta, Pepsodent Daily, Patanjali brush
skuLines.notes: Highest unit-volume line in the category. At a 3-month replacement norm, 5,000 residents would be ~20,000 brushes a year — assume half that in practice, which is still the biggest single-unit count ARY sells in oral care.

skuLines.examples: Colgate ZigZag 2+1, Oral-B 123 4-pack, Pepsodent triple pack, Colgate Super Flexi multipack
skuLines.notes: Married-staff families buy the multipack; hostel wardens buy cartons. Worth quoting a case-lot price to the hostels rather than letting them walk in one pack at a time.

skuLines.examples: Colgate SlimSoft Charcoal, Oral-B Sensitive, Sensodyne Sensitive brush, Perfora bamboo/aluminium
skuLines.notes: Sell it physically beside the sensitivity paste — same buyer, same trip, and it lifts a ₹200 basket to ₹350.

skuLines.line: Toothbrush — kids 2-6, extra soft small head
skuLines.examples: Colgate Kids 2-5 (Barbie / Minions), Oral-B Disney, Chicco, Dentoshine
skuLines.notes: Character licence drives the child's choice, not the parent's — carry 2-3 different characters, not 3 of one.

skuLines.examples: Colgate Kids 6+, Oral-B Junior, Pepsodent Kids
skuLines.notes: The size gap most stores miss — an 8-year-old is sold either a toddler brush or an adult one. In a school township this band deserves its own facing.

skuLines.line: Toothbrush — baby first brush / silicone finger brush
skuLines.examples: MeeMee finger brush, Chicco first brush 3-6m, Buddsbuddy silicone, U-shape baby brush
skuLines.notes: Zero local alternative for a first-time mother on campus. One or two facings closes a real gap; long shelf life so there is no spoilage risk in carrying it.

skuLines.examples: Oral-B Ortho brush, ICPA Ortho brush, Colgate ortho
skuLines.notes: Braces are common in the 12-25 group and those patients already travel out for adjustments — they will buy supplies on campus if they exist. Small SKU count, no competition within 30 km.

skuLines.examples: ICPA Proxa Narrow Space, Oral-B interdental, Thermoseal Proxa, GUM soft-picks
skuLines.notes: Serves both the braces cohort and gum-treatment patients. Pharma-route supply (ICPA), same order as the clinical pastes.

skuLines.examples: Oral-B battery brush, Colgate ProClinical 150, Caresmith battery
skuLines.packSizes: Single, boxed; AA cells sold separately
skuLines.seasonality: Festival and gifting season; session start
skuLines.notes: Stock AA cells right beside it or the sale dies at the counter. The realistic electric entry point for this township, well below the rechargeable band.

skuLines.examples: Perfora sonic, Oral-B Vitality, Philips Sonicare entry, Oracura
skuLines.notes: Slow-moving and capital-heavy — 1-2 display pieces maximum. The ₹999-₹1,999 band is where Indian mid-income households actually convert in 2026. Power cuts and charger dependency are a real objection in this location.

skuLines.examples: Oral-B EB20 2-3 pack, Perfora heads, Sonicare heads
skuLines.notes: Only stock heads that fit handles ARY actually sold, or it is guaranteed dead stock. This is the classic mis-buy in a small store's electric range.

skuLines.examples: Stainless steel tongue cleaner, Perfora copper tongue cleaner (₹154), brass cleaner
skuLines.seasonality: Session opening — near-universal in an Indian hostel starter kit
skuLines.notes: Best margin-to-price ratio in the lane. Plain steel rusts in the Baru Sahib monsoon — buy stainless or copper, and do not carry deep stock through Jul-Sep.

skuLines.examples: Plastic tongue cleaner, Dentoshine lollipop tongue cleaner for kids
skuLines.notes: The ₹10-₹20 plastic one is what a school student on pocket money actually buys; the kids' novelty version sells to parents of 3-8s.

skuLines.examples: Neem datun bundles, miswak/peelu sticks, babool datun
skuLines.seasonality: Steady, with lifts around religious observance periods
skuLines.notes: Culturally and religiously comfortable, and locally sourceable in Sirmaur — a rare line where hill location is an advantage, not a cost. But they mould fast in heavy monsoon: buy small, buy often, store dry and elevated.

skuLines.examples: Colgate Plax Peppermint 250ml, Listerine Cool Mint 250ml, Colgate MaxFresh Plax Elaichi 250ml
skuLines.notes: 250ml is the right depth-per-rupee for this store: the 750ml bottle is cheaper per ml but far worse on hill freight and shelf space.

skuLines.examples: Colgate Plax 0% alcohol, Sensodyne Complete Protection+ alcohol-free 250ml, Himalaya Active Fresh 215ml
skuLines.notes: In a Sikh institution alcohol-free should be the DEFAULT facing and alcohol-containing Listerine Original the exception. A resident reading the label matters far more here than a ₹10 price gap — get this shelf order right or the whole sub-category underperforms.

skuLines.examples: Listerine 750ml, Colgate Plax 500ml, Sensodyne 500ml
skuLines.notes: Best rupees-per-ml for staff families, but the heaviest, bulkiest, lowest-value-density item in the lane — worst freight profile on 30-50 km of hill road. Keep depth low and reorder often rather than holding a pallet.

skuLines.examples: Himalaya Active Fresh Miswak / Saunf / Mint 215ml (₹150), Dabur Red mouthwash, Colgate Vedshakti
skuLines.notes: Naturally alcohol-free, which is why it fits this campus better than the mainstream range. Saunf/miswak flavours sell to the older staff who reject mint rinses.

skuLines.examples: Listerine 80ml, Colgate Plax 60-100ml, single-use rinse sachets
skuLines.seasonality: Session opening; school trip and tour weeks
skuLines.notes: The trial size that gets a student into the category at all — mouthwash penetration in India is low and ₹150 is a hard first purchase for a 15-year-old.

skuLines.examples: Hexidine 160ml, Clohex / Clohex Plus, Rexidin-M, Colgate Periogard 250ml (₹385)
skuLines.notes: Drug-licence item. Real demand post-extraction and during gum treatment — exactly the follow-up a resident cannot buy on campus today. Stains teeth on prolonged use; repeat the dentist's 2-week caution at the counter.

skuLines.examples: Betadine gargle 100ml, Zaigargle, medicated salt-gargle sachets
skuLines.seasonality: Large winter spike Nov-Feb in a cold hill township, plus monsoon throat infections
skuLines.notes: Drug-licence item. This and the sensitivity paste are the two genuinely climate-driven lines in oral care here — in a residential school, a winter sore-throat wave hits thousands of people in the same fortnight, so stock ahead of it, not after.

skuLines.examples: Dentoshine kids mouthwash, Phos-Flur, Colgate kids rinse
skuLines.notes: 6+ only and supervised use — the school's health room is a more likely buyer than a parent. Thin retail demand; one facing.

skuLines.examples: Oral-B Essential Floss 50m, Colgate ZigZag floss 25m, Thermoseal floss, Perfora floss
skuLines.notes: Floss penetration in India is genuinely low, so keep this shallow — but a residential university block and every braces patient are the two pockets that do buy, and both are concentrated here. Very long shelf life, zero spoilage risk.

skuLines.examples: Dr Fresh floss picks 50-100pc, Oral-B Satin floss picks, 3-in-1 flosser with tongue cleaner (100pc ≈ ₹66)
skuLines.notes: The pick format is what actually moves in India, not spool floss — if only one floss line is carried, carry this one. Good margin, light, indestructible in transit.

skuLines.examples: Perfora Power Water Flosser (₹2,230), Caresmith Blast, Oracura OC009
skuLines.notes: One display piece at most. Ortho patients are the only repeat buyers and there are perhaps a few dozen on campus. Do not tie up working capital in depth here.

skuLines.examples: Wooden toothpick jar 100-500pc, plastic toothpick dispenser, mint-flavoured picks
skuLines.notes: General-store staple with the widest margin headroom in the lane, and both ARY canteens are buyers. Decide whether the canteen counters indent it or the POS store retails it, so it is not ordered twice at two prices.

skuLines.examples: STIM Ex Wax strips, GC ortho relief wax, generic ortho wax
skuLines.notes: The single most "nobody-else-has-it" SKU in this lane: a 14-year-old with a wire cutting into their cheek, no transport, and 30-50 km to the nearest option. Two pieces on the shelf costs almost nothing.

skuLines.examples: ICPA Clinsodent powder, Fittydent cleansing tablets, Retainer Brite
skuLines.notes: Serves both the aligner/retainer students and the denture cohort — one SKU, two buyers. Long shelf life; keep sealed against monsoon humidity.

skuLines.examples: Fixon powder & cream 15-20g, Fittydent adhesive cream, Dentofix, Poligrip (imported)
skuLines.notes: The zero-substitute item of the whole category. An elderly resident who runs out faces a 30-50 km hill trip or eats badly for a week — nothing else on any shelf substitutes. Volume is tiny: carry 2-3 pieces and never let it hit zero. Pharma-route supply.

skuLines.examples: ICPA Clinsodent tablets, Fittydent cleansing tablets, Val-Clean
skuLines.notes: Long shelf life makes hill logistics easy — there is no good reason for this to be absent. Shelve it physically touching the adhesive: it is one buying occasion, and the elderly buyer will not hunt two aisles.

skuLines.line: Denture brush / denture box / appliance case
skuLines.examples: Denture brush, denture soaking box, retainer and aligner case
skuLines.notes: Cheap, unbreakable, never expires, high margin, and completes the denture set into a three-item basket. Also sells to every student with a retainer.

skuLines.line: Teeth whitening — strips / pen / purple serum
skuLines.examples: Perfora Purple Magic serum (₹887), Oracura whitening strips, whitening pen, Colgate Visible White booster gel
skuLines.packSizes: Single serum bottle, 7-14 strip packs, pen
skuLines.notes: Genuinely new in 2025-26 and margin-rich, but occasion-driven — buy against convocation and wedding season, not as a standing line.

skuLines.examples: Mentos, Chlormint, Center Fresh, Orbit sugar-free, Listerine PocketPaks
skuLines.notes: Counter impulse at the POS. On a campus with no tobacco or alcohol this is the entire "freshen up" occasion, so it over-indexes here versus a normal store. Overlaps confectionery — assign one counter as owner so it is not double-ordered at two costs.

skuLines.line: Mukhwas / saunf / meetha paan mouth freshener (tobacco- and supari-free)
skuLines.examples: Coloured saunf 250g, Rajasthani mukhwas 400g, meetha paan mukhwas, roasted dhania-dal mix
skuLines.packSizes: 100g / 250g / 400g jars and pouches; loose by weight
skuLines.seasonality: Lifts around langar and festival meals, Gurpurab gatherings, visiting-parent weekends
skuLines.notes: Must be certified tobacco-free AND supari/areca-free for this campus — verify the label, not the salesman. The after-meal ritual is a large real occasion here and one of the clearest places a resident's wallet leaks off-campus. Loose sale by weight lifts margin further; keep airtight against monsoon damp.

skuLines.line: Oral care starter kit / hostel bundle (ARY's own bundle)
skuLines.examples: brush + 100g paste + steel tongue cleaner + 100ml mouthwash, shrink-wrapped; junior version with kids paste and small brush
skuLines.seasonality: Session opening (Apr, Jul, post-winter-break Feb) — the one week ARY could sell 1,000+
skuLines.notes: Built in-house from lines already stocked, so it needs no new vendor, no new SKU and no extra freight. Turns a four-item hunt by a newly arrived 12-year-old into one bill and pulls the average bill well above ₹208 — the cheapest revenue lift in this whole category.

trends2026: Hydroxyapatite (nano-HAP) fluoride-free toothpaste moved from niche to the main premium hook — Himalaya's Botanique Whitening+ HAP retails at ₹444/113g on its own site, alongside Perfora, Oracura and Dr Sheth's. The claim that sells is 'fluoride-free but still remineralising', which also lands well with parents of small children.

Purple colour-correcting whitening went mass in 2025-26: Colgate now sells a Visible White Purple 240g SKU in general trade, while D2C purple serums sit above it (Perfora Purple Magic ~₹887). Whitening has broken out of the paste format into serums, pens and strips.

D2C oral-care brands crossed into offline and q-commerce — Perfora (10 mn+ orders shipped), Oracura, Clove Dental, Salt. Oral Care. They carry 25-40% retail margins versus 8-14% on mass toothpaste, and their Blinkit/Zepto pricing now sets the reference price even in places those apps do not deliver.

Sonic/electric brushes hit the ₹999-₹1,999 band (Perfora, Caresmith, Oracura), the first price point at which Indian mid-income households actually convert. IMARC flags aluminium handles, timers and pressure sensors plus a sustainability pitch as the 2026 story.

Oil pulling got formalised into retail SKUs rather than a home remedy — Dabur Red Pulling Oil, EKDO 2-in-1 oil-pulling mouthwash, cold-pressed coconut pulling oils. Classic ayurveda repackaged in a modern format at a modern price.

Kids' oral care professionalised: IDA-accepted claims on pack, colour-changing pastes (Clove Kidz), age-banded 0-2 / 3-5 / 6-9 SKUs from Colgate, and 'fluoride-free' plus 'SLS-free' as the parent's actual decision criteria (Dentoshine, MeeMee, STIM Junior, Little Joys).

Alcohol-free and SLS-free became default claims rather than premium add-ons — Colgate Plax 0% alcohol, Sensodyne Complete Protection+ alcohol-free, and every herbal rinse. Convenient for institutional buyers who need alcohol-free by policy.

Metal accessories as an ayurveda-meets-sustainability crossover: copper tongue cleaners now sell at ~₹154 against ₹20-40 for plain steel, and bamboo/aluminium brush handles have a small but real premium following.
adjacentServices: Term-start starter-kit pre-order: hostel wardens and the school office submit block-wise counts before session opening; ARY packs and delivers to the block. Converts the arrival-week scramble into a planned, forecastable buy and captures the whole cohort's first purchase.

Standing auto-refill for the zero-substitute lines — denture adhesive, denture cleansing tablets, sensitivity paste, a specific prescription paste — against named residents, with monthly stock reserved. Prevents the failure mode where the one person who needs it finds it out of stock.

Dental-camp tie-in with a visiting dentist from Rajgarh/Solan/Nahan once or twice a year: ARY pre-stocks the exact follow-ups the camp prescribes (chlorhexidine rinse, ortho wax, interdental brushes, desensitising paste) so scripts get filled on campus instead of on a trip to town.

A named orthodontic corner: one small shelf holding ortho brush, relief wax, interdental brushes, floss threaders and retainer cleaner. Few SKUs, no competition inside 30 km, and it serves the 12-25 braces cohort that is unusually dense in a school-plus-university township.

Brush-replacement prompt at the till: with 7.2 bills per resident per month the POS sees almost everyone often, so flagging a customer's last brush purchase at 3 months converts a habit nobody follows into recurring units.

Institutional indent supply to the two canteens, the F&V counter and the junior hostels — toothpicks, brushes and bulk paste on a monthly purchase order rather than retail walk-in, at a case-lot price.

Weekly consolidated special-order run to Solan/Nahan for the long tail — a specific electric brush head, an imported denture product, a prescribed paste — so a resident never makes the 30-50 km trip for one item. This is the service that plugs the wallet leak, not more shelf depth.

Used-brush and empty-tube collection drive: cheap, visible goodwill with a school and university population, and it is what makes the sustainability-positioned premium lines (bamboo handles, copper cleaners) credible rather than just expensive.

WebSearch was unavailable — the session's 200-call budget was already exhausted by other agents, so this lane is built from direct fetches plus category knowledge.

CAVEAT ON NUMBERS: price bands are stated as realistic Indian MRP ranges, NOT the scraped figures — Flipkart marketplace prices ran well above MRP on mass SKUs (e.g. Dabur Babool 175g listed at ₹155 against a ~₹75 MRP), so scraped prices were used to confirm formats and pack sizes, not price levels. Margin bands are my estimates from Indian FMCG trade norms (mass toothpaste thin at 8-14%, accessories and private-label-style lines 30-50%); they were not scraped from any source and should be checked against ARY's actual purchase terms before being used for planning.
